newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Elec sets '97 sales at 4.5 trln.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Elec sets '97 sales at 4.5 trln.

text.p: Daewoo Electronics Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Monday it has set a sales target at 4.5 trillion won for calendar 1997, up from an estimated sales of 3.8 trillion for this year.
The company's sales totalled 3.13 trillion won in 1995.
Daewoo Electronics said last month it wanted to increase exports to $3.8 billion in 1997 from an estimated $2.8 billion this year.
The company also plans to increase its overall investment by 20 percent to 1.2 trillion won in 1997. No details were given.
Daewoo earlier said it planned to invest about $1.0 billion in the next five years to reinforce its research and development efforts.
